remarks: Tucked away in the pulse of exciting downtown Stamford, you'll find this special slice of heaven! Very spacious, immaculate and bright with everything you could ever want, this garden style apartment features lush views from the balcony, a sunny open flow, living room with wood burning fireplace, large master bedroom, reserved garage parking, central air, amazing storage inside and a separate storage room in the garage. Relax in the enchanting courtyard with tranquil fountain surrounded by beautiful greenery. Come see this inviting sanctuary located in the heart of the sophisticated city where you can stroll to popular restaurants, bars, theater, library and shopping.
